Level is Emergency although the header says 'urgent attention'; defensible because an unconscious, fitting patient is an airway emergency and the page escalates to urgent referral/ventilation, but it is not the house default (Urgent) and should be noted for review.

elements.problem: No head-injury finding is checked; the p30 route can never be triggered from this page.

elements.problem: No pregnancy/postpartum finding is checked; the eclampsia branch is lost.

elements.scope_reason: 'Fit has lasted ≥ 5 minutes ... refer urgently' is a time criterion the language can express ((>= (onset (clinical_finding Seizure)) (time_ago 5 minutes))) and is the operational definition of status epilepticus; the rest of the element is medication.

elements.problem: The one triage discriminator in the algorithm (fit ≥ 5 min) is not encoded; the Emergency rule fires on any unconscious fitting patient regardless of duration, so it neither distinguishes status epilepticus nor carries the 'refer urgently' trigger.

parts_missing: slow or shallow breathing (Bradypnea / Shallow breathing) as check item or escalation
elements.problem: Not encoded; low impact since the Emergency rule already fires.

rule_level_problems.problem: Priority is Emergency while the red-box header says 'urgent attention'. House standard maps red box → Urgent unless the page explicitly escalates; airway compromise/unconsciousness arguably justifies it, but this should be confirmed against the Seizure warning-sign level in shared/warning_signs.ts.

The file encodes only the box header. The red box's discriminating findings (current head injury, glucose < 3/< 4 mmol/L with diabetes, pregnancy ≥ 20 weeks/postpartum ≤ 1 week, fit ≥ 5 minutes) are absent from check_for and from every rule, so the routes to p19, p30 and p177 and the status-epilepticus threshold are all lost.

rule_level_problems.rule: Check for unconsciousness in the fitting patient
rule_level_problems.problem: check_for contains only 'Unconscious'; the house standard requires every red-box item in the check list. No status epilepticus / eclampsia / hypoglycaemia 'possible' rules exist even though the page's routing implies them.

summary: The two rules correctly capture the box trigger (seizure + unconscious) but nothing else: the fit ≥ 5 minutes threshold (status epilepticus, expressible with time_ago minutes) and the routing discriminators (current head injury → p30, glucose < 3 / < 4 mmol/L in diabetes → p19, pregnancy ≥ 20 weeks or ≤ 1 week postpartum → p177) are missing from check_for and all rules. The Emergency level is defensible but exceeds the header's 'urgent attention' and should be confirmed.
